classification.difficultyReason: Part b is the hardest essential demand and has the same structure as the p27-q4 part b. The student must derive the prism's surface area unaided, equate to get a+b=4 and ab=-21, find the pair 7 and -3 by sum-product, and apply a>b. There is no part (a) scaffold, so it is slightly harder than p27-q4. Part a is a routine coefficient match with unknowns in the leading coefficient, constant and linear terms, solved in a fixed order, and is easier than part b. All steps are linked routine procedures with no hidden insight, so it sits below A5.

content.prompt: A rectangular prism has width $w$ cm, length $(x+a)$ cm and height $(x+b)$ cm, where $a$ and $b$ are integers, $a>b$, $x>3$ and $w>0$.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
Find the missing values by equating coefficients.
$$(ax+3)(x-b)-x(x+c)=5x^2-10x-6$$

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}ax^2-abx+3x-3b-x^2-cx&=5x^2-10x-6\\(a-1)x^2+(3-ab-c)x-3b&=5x^2-10x-6\end{aligned}$$
Equating coefficients of $x^2$:
$$\begin{aligned}a-1&=5\\a&=6\end{aligned}$$
Equating constant terms:
$$\begin{aligned}-3b&=-6\\b&=2\end{aligned}$$
Equating coefficients of $x$:
$$\begin{aligned}3-ab-c&=-10\\3-12-c&=-10\\c&=1\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt:
If the surface area of the rectangular prism is equivalent to the expression
$$2w(2x+4)+2x^2+8x-42\text{ cm}^2,$$
find $a$ and $b$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}S&=2w(2x+a+b)+2\bigl[x^2+(a+b)x+ab\bigr]\\&=4xw+2(a+b)w+2x^2+2(a+b)x+2ab.\end{align*}$$
Equating the coefficients of $w$ and the constant terms gives
$$\begin{align*}2(a+b)&=8\\a+b&=4\\2ab&=-42\\ab&=-21.\end{align*}$$
PSF: Product $-21$, Sum $4$, Factors $7$ and $-3$.
Since $a>b$, $a=7$ and $b=-3$.
